method: Offline re-screen of all 1,683 cached official court full texts with one complete whitespace-insensitive matcher; no network requests

batches.throttle_scope: per worker, not global across parallel workers
batches.provenance: Historical acquisition metadata only; all rows were re-screened with the single matcher above. Original batch files are not required replay inputs.

batches.provenance: Historical acquisition metadata only; all rows were re-screened with the single matcher above. Original batch files are not required replay inputs.

limitation: Phrase absence only, not substantive irrelevance or full P1-P7 saturation. Hits are candidates needing review, never exclusions. The earlier 1,500-item screening and discovery snapshots retain their original historical methods.

matcher.engine: Python re, Unicode default, no flags
matcher.normalization: Remove every Unicode whitespace character using re.sub(r"\s+", "", text) before matching. The nine patterns are batch 1 signals with all whitespace removed; this is a superset of every original batch matcher.

evidence.source_url: Official per-ID LSW precInfoP.do URL; original fetched_at and acquisition batch are retained on every row.
evidence.screened_text_sha256: Standard SRI sha256-<Base64 digest> string: the sha256- prefix followed by RFC 4648 standard Base64 (with padding) of the 32 SHA-256 digest bytes of the exact UTF-8 bytes of the decoded PrecService.판례내용 string BEFORE whitespace normalization. This represents the same digest bytes as hexadecimal SHA-256. No trimming, HTML decoding, newline conversion, JSON serialization, or BOM is added. This is not a digest of the HTTP response or full JSON payload.
evidence.screened_text_bytes: Byte length of precisely the same pre-normalization UTF-8 text used for screened_text_sha256.
evidence.matcher_id: Every row must equal matcher.id in this run record.
evidence.retention: Raw full texts remain in local caches and are not committed. The URL, text digest, byte length, and pinned matcher identify the screened content for later comparison; replay requires the exact matching cached or refetched text.
